test_title: PYST 31: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : WQM :: TNJ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : WQM :: TNJ : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = KUY, % = QKJ**

**For # (KUY) to WQM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe2e3e50f588260deb72bdad1e1095db85d95755c470bd37c4301971836ead54.png] 

**For TNJ to % (QKJ)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b17663669f046f35828806dac3a46ed8e9397c0e5a790288e29ff4b6d2c8a8a.png] 

**Option 2) # = ZTP, % = QKG**

**For # (ZTP) to WQM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/379fedfbf1e9d5ea6969d37f130e7b2233adb2a8a620e18b3e63753fd1ec0cb7.png] 

**For TNJ to % (QKG)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4ebc2153cbb9c013df2c157f4705689da9a8a8c8808fb6973de44d1ce172e1f.png] 

Since the pattern for ZTP to WQM (-3, -3, -3) is the same as the pattern for TNJ to QKG (-3, -3, -3),

**Option 2 is correct.**

**Option 3) # = JTP, % = MWR**

**For # (JTP) to WQM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa6960b0672748342f3e4a9514dae38c024d7ec45cd3ae42795372ff4b414f74.png] 

**For TNJ to % (MWR)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39e1b5401104704578596a093950d3f6342913dcec38df5ecb502803bd5041d7.png] 

**Option 4) # = MKP, % = QPI**

**For # (MKP) to WQM**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee0b114a4f49c34dcdc280a5d97c680c2ba349fa742d68baf76ba2b61541d9e6.png] 

**For TNJ to % (QPI)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcc5bcc04961986c4a701b02c6a6908afccf355a8d72cad9c6196cbdf9037a99.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
